decision.rationale: Authorisation AUTH-008201 was posted twice to card CRD-000044 at LARKSPUR GETAWAYS (MER-000052). The two postings are TXN-008001 (1130.53 EUR, made 2026-07-24T13:09:36Z) and TXN-008002 (1130.53 EUR, made 2026-07-24T13:10:36Z), and both were posted on 2026-07-25. AUTH-008201 is a single approval for 1130.53 EUR, so this is one authorisation posted twice. The ledger shows no refund of either posting. The only other charge at this merchant, TXN-001372 on 2026-08-18, is a different amount under a different authorisation and is not part of this dispute. Time limit: the dispute was opened on 2026-10-28, 95 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit. Under duplicate-same-authorisation, the extra posting is credited. Its amount, 1130.53 EUR, equals the claimed amount and is below the 3,000.00 EUR limit for provisional credit, so only that one posting is credited.
